info.name: HealthOS API - Complete Collection
info.description: Comprehensive, production-ready Postman collection for all 78 HealthOS endpoints across identity, organization, scheduling, care/encounters/SOAP, governance, and administration. Every endpoint includes realistic request bodies and saved 200/201 Success and 400/404 Error responses.
